P_topology.edge_provenance: Every atomic edge records generating triangle, orientation, and base/leg role.
P_topology.vertex_provenance: Every vertex records incident parent sides and native apex/base-point/intersection/triple-concurrency types.
P_topology.address_space: profile-scoped deterministic IDs; equal ordinals across profiles do not assert cross-profile identity

P_construction.available: Chiodo conditions and high-level two-fold/Apollonius construction claims
P_construction.not_available: complete point-by-point Chiodo construction DAG and authenticated Mahesh/Kulaichev derivational ledgers
P_construction.non_equivalence: P_construction does not establish P_topology and is not inferred from graph adjacency

printed_syg_mapping.required_bridge: SYG numbered vertex/edge <-> coordinate vertex/atomic edge <-> generating triangle/side
blockers: No coordinate key accompanies the supplied numbering.
The printed adjacency has 140 edges, but the 69-vertex/74-bounded-face coordinate arrangement has 142.
The printed face-boundary pairs do not directly agree with its primal adjacency labels.
printed_syg_mapping.allowed_use: motif hypothesis and comparison only; not canonical provenance

mahesh_mapping.required: M1-M18 coordinates, triangle-triple incidence table, orientation convention, and construction order

firewall: P_topology and P_construction are stored separately.
Graph structure cannot substitute for non-structural geometric dependence.
Construction order cannot be promoted to intrinsic necessity without an independent proof.
